text: At its meeting on Thursday, April 25, 2024, the Toronto Parking Authority – Audit and Risk Management Committee considered Item PR5.1 and made recommendations to the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority. Summary from the report (April 3, 2024) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority: The purpose of this report is to establish the 2024 Work Plan (Attachment 2) for Audit and Risk Management Committee of the Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority and to review its Terms of Reference as noted in Attachment 1.
The Board of Directors of the Toronto Parking Authority: 1. Received the report (April 3, 2024) from the President, Toronto Parking Authority for information.
